preconditions.description: The input root must be a valid TreeNode object.
The number of nodes in the tree must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**5 for node in list(root))
preconditions.description: The value of each node must be between 1 and 100,000.

postconditions.description: The length of the output list must equal the number of nodes in the tree.
The output list must contain the inorder traversal of the tree.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in stdout)
postconditions.description: All elements in the output list must be integers.
